headline: Telefonica Germany ties 1,100 job cuts to AI
body: A quiet day with one story. O2 Germany confirmed it will cut more than 1,100 jobs by end-2026, citing greater use of AI. That slightly lowers Shared Prosperity, nudging Egalitarian Utopia down. Other lines drifted as earlier news faded. Horizon Balance eased to -1.70.
movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia -0.1 came from the Telefonica Germany job cuts (-0.06); everything else moved by under 0.1.
